item.text: I’m checking the reconstructed 10-K JSON directly and will pull the year-end long-term debt value from the relevant balance sheet or debt note.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "jq -r '.texts[] | select((.text|test(\"long-term debt|long term debt|debt at year-end|year-end\";\"i\"))) | [.page_no, .text] | @tsv' /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/INTEL_2022_10K_reconstructed.json | head -n 200"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '.texts[] | select((.text|test(\"long-term debt|long term debt|debt at year-end|year-end\";\"i\"))) | [.page_no, .text] | @tsv' /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/INTEL_2022_10K_reconstructed.json | head -n 200"
